name: mihoyo-style
goal: Push the flagship HSR/Genshin (miHoYo house style) recipe past the img2img crutch: pure txt2img, tag-carried identity, style from the HSR v3 LoRA + official-art tags alone. Jean (Genshin, 2020) and Acheron (HSR 2.1, 2024-03) are both inside NoobAI's 2024-10-23 cutoff, so identity needs no reference — this isolates the STYLE stack. Jean also tests cross-IP generalization (Genshin character through the HSR-trained LoRA).

notes: Prompt merge order: style carriers (official art, game cg) -> character -> scene -> quality scaffold. GROUNDING AUDIT 2026-08-05: 7 of 9 original style tags were MISS in the tag DB ('HD', 'detailed', 'detailed color', 'smooth color', 'smooth shading', 'soft shading', 'faint glow'); 'reflective eyes' aliases to eye_reflection at 1.6k posts. Dead tags dilute attention -- CLAUDE.md #4. REFINEMENT ROUND 2026-08-09 (current base): second grounding sweep for smooth coloration / lighting / reflection / shading. Winners, all grounded: gradient hair (216k) + gradient eyes (12.7k) for smooth colour transitions, glint (37k) + shiny skin (154k) for specular/reflection, sparkle (224k) replacing light particles (79k), painterly (10k) + blurry background (181k) for painterly separation, and purple theme (13.5k) on Acheron for palette harmony. Confirmed MISS -- do not reach for these again: cel shading, soft lighting, dramatic lighting, rim light, gradient, smooth, specular highlights, ambient occlusion, digital painting, vivid colors, detailed background, glossy. SAMPLER A/B RESOLVED 2026-08-09: the docs/tuning.md 'official-art finish' recipe (dpmpp_2m/karras/cfg 5.5) DOES NOT TRANSFER to the noobai v-pred lineage -- it washed Acheron's night sky from deep blue-black to lavender haze and blew Jean's highlights. The karras sigma schedule clips the terminal sigma that v-pred + ZTSNR relies on for true blacks. That recipe is eps-lineage guidance (CLAUDE.md #3: settings don't transfer between lineages). Keep euler/normal/cfg 5.0. Evidence: out/{jean,acheron}-s2.png vs -s1. backlighting stays OUT: it lifts blacks on night scenes. hires 1.5x/denoise 0.55; scale >1.5 hangs the 17GB Mac. cowboy shot framing is load-bearing for face quality (full body = ~90px face). (logo:1.3) mandatory: the v3 LoRA renders the HSR logo on txt2img.
